declarations.description:
An idea tree laid out around a central topic, with keyboard editing as in XMind and Miro. The map draws itself
from a JSON tree (`data`, one root node `{ id, label, children?, collapsed?, side?, color?, icon? }`); with
`editable` the user adds, edits, moves, folds and deletes topics, and every edit fires a cancelable
`before-change` and then `change` with the new `data`, which is where an app saves it. The map keeps its own copy,
so typing and undo never wait for the app.

The central topic is a filled card, first-level topics are boxes tinted with their branch colour, and deeper
topics are text on a line, joined by curves that thin at each level. `layout="both"` (the default) balances the
branches on either side of the centre, and `left` or `right` draws a one-sided logic chart. Topics are measured in
the page, so long labels wrap at `--c2-mind-map__topic--max-width` and the layout follows; after an edit they glide
to their new place (not under reduced motion).

The canvas is a `c2-pan-zoom`: a drag on empty canvas or the wheel pans, Ctrl/⌘ + wheel zooms, `controls` adds the
zoom toolbar and `minimap` an overview. The focused topic is always brought into view.

### Keyboard

The map is one tab stop and an ARIA tree. The arrows follow the drawing: on the right side → goes to the first
subtopic (unfolding a folded topic) and ← to the parent, mirrored on the left; ↑ and ↓ go to the previous and next
sibling, then to the nearest topic on the same level. Home goes to the central topic, Space folds, Ctrl/⌘ + `+`,
`-` and `0` zoom and fit. While `editable`: Tab or Insert adds a subtopic, Enter a sibling after (Shift+Enter
before), F2 or typing edits the label, Delete or Backspace removes the topic, Alt + the arrows move it (↑ ↓
reorder, toward the centre promotes, away from it nests it in the previous sibling), Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes and
Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Z redoes, and copy and paste use an indented list. **Because Tab adds a subtopic, it does not leave
an editable map: Escape moves focus to the canvas, and from there Tab leaves.** Insert is the alternative to Tab.
In the editor, Enter commits, Shift+Enter adds a line break, Tab commits and adds a subtopic and Escape cancels.

A drag on a topic of an editable map moves it: onto another topic makes it that topic's last subtopic, onto the
upper or lower edge of one puts it before or after it. Escape cancels the drag; `no-drag` turns it off.

The server cannot measure text, so it renders the topics as an indented outline; the browser lays the map out on
its second render.

members.name: data
members.description:
The map: one root node `{ id, label, children?, collapsed?, side?, color?, icon? }`. Unknown fields are kept. The
map edits its own copy and fires `change` with the new object; setting `data` again replaces the map and clears
the undo history.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the map. Default: "Mind map".

members.name: layout
members.description: `both` puts branches on either side of the central topic; `left` and `right` put them all on one side.

members.name: editable
members.description: Lets the user add, edit, move and delete topics. Navigation, folding and `node-click` work either way.

members.name: noDrag
members.description: Turns off drag to reparent in an editable map, so a drag on a topic pans like a drag on the canvas.

members.name: controls
members.description: Draws the zoom toolbar: zoom out, the zoom percent, zoom in and fit.

members.name: minimap
members.description: Draws an overview of the map in the corner while it overflows the canvas.

members.name: #own
members.description: The data `data` held when the map last adopted it, or the map's own last edit.

members.name: #visible
members.description: The drawn topics, in drawing order.

members.name: #escaped
members.description: Escape moved focus to the canvas: no topic is a tab stop, so Tab leaves the map.

members.name: #laidOut
members.description: False on the server and in the first client render, which draw the indented outline.

members.name: #renderedLaidOut
members.description: Whether the render being finished drew the map rather than the outline.

members.name: #boxes
members.description: Where every drawn topic goes, relative to the centre of the central topic.

members.name: #drawn
members.description: Where every drawn topic is now: the same as `#boxes`, except while topics glide to a new layout.

members.name: #revealId
members.description: A topic to bring into view once the next layout is done.

members.name: #focusId
members.description: A topic to focus once the next render is done; with `#focusEditor`, its editor.

members.name: panZoom
members.description: The inner `c2-pan-zoom`, for `zoomTo()`, `centerOn()` or `view-change`. Null before the first render.

members.name: selectedNode
members.description: The selected topic.

members.name: getNode
members.description: The topic with the given id, wherever it sits.

members.name: addChild
members.description: Adds a subtopic to `id` (the selected topic by default) and opens it in the editor. Returns the new id.

members.name: addSibling
members.description:
Adds a sibling after `id` (the selected topic by default), or before it with `before`, and opens it in the
editor. On the central topic it adds a subtopic. Returns the new id.

members.name: edit
members.description: Opens the inline editor on `id` (the selected topic by default).

members.name: removeTopic
members.description:
Removes `id` (the selected topic by default) and its subtopics. The central topic cannot be removed. (Named
`removeTopic` because `remove()` takes the element itself out of the page.)

members.name: select
members.description: Selects `id` and brings it into view, without `selection-change`. Focus moves to it when the map holds focus.

members.name: fold
members.description: Folds `id` (the selected topic by default), unfolds it with `folded = false`, or toggles it.

members.name: setColor
members.description: Sets the branch colour of `id` (the selected topic by default); `null` goes back to the branch colours in turn.

members.name: undo
members.description: Undoes the last edit. Up to 100 edits are kept.

members.name: redo
members.description: Redoes the last undone edit.

members.name: fit
members.description: Fits the whole map in the canvas.

members.name: #sync
members.description: Adopts `data` when the app set it, rather than the map's own edit.

members.name: #pinSides
members.description: Gives every first-level topic an explicit side, so an edit among them does not rebalance the others.

members.name: #apply
members.description:
Applies an edit: `before-change` (cancelable), the undo step, the new document, `change` and the announcement.
`select` is the topic selected afterwards (the action's node by default).

members.name: #revealHidden
members.description: Unfolds the folded ancestors of `id`, so it is drawn (a change of its own, like a fold).

members.name: #closeEditor
members.description: Closes the editor; `commit` saves the draft as the label when it changed and is not blank.

members.name: #siblingsOnSide
members.description: The drawn siblings of a topic on its side of the map, top to bottom.

members.name: #reorder
members.description: Alt+↑ / Alt+↓: swaps places with the previous or next sibling on the same side.

members.name: #promote
members.description: Alt + the arrow toward the centre: the topic becomes the sibling after its parent.

members.name: #demote
members.description: Alt + the arrow away from the centre: the topic becomes the last subtopic of its previous sibling.

members.name: #measure
members.description: Measures the drawn topics and lays the map out again when a size or the structure changed.

members.name: #outerAnchor
members.description: The point where a topic's connectors to its subtopics start, on its outer side.

members.name: #navigate
members.description: The topic an arrow key leads to: the arrows follow the drawing.

members.name: #dropTarget
members.description: The topic under the pointer and where the dragged topic would land: into it, or before or after it.

members.name: #focusedEntry
members.description: The focused topic, when focus is on one of this map's topics and not in its editor.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after an edit, with `{ data, action }`: `data` is the new map, to save. `action` is `{ type, node, parent, index }`; `type` is `add`, `edit`, `delete`, `move`, `collapse`, `expand`, `color`, `paste`, `undo` or `redo`.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired when the user selects another topic, with `{ node }`. Does not bubble: several components fire `selection-change`, so a listener belongs on the element itself.
Fired before an edit, with `{ action }`. Cancelable: `preventDefault()` vetoes the edit.
events.name: before-change

events.description: Fired when a topic is clicked, or activated with Enter in a read-only map, with `{ node }`. Fired in read-only maps too, to open a topic's details.
events.name: node-click
